business_summary.text: Ind-Swift Laboratories Limited is a pharmaceutical company focused on finished dosage formulations (FDF) with a strong presence in export markets and growing CDMO partnerships.

call_points.text: CDMO partnerships with Viatris, Manx and Arrotex commercialized, expected to contribute ₹200-220 Cr in FY27
Export gross margins at 55%, with 18% EBITDA margin sustainable and potential to reach 21-22%
₹250 Cr cash to be deployed over 2.5 years, no plans for Synthimed divestment this year
FY30 vision targets ₹1500 Cr revenue and ₹200+ Cr net profit with sustainable margins
